transcript:
Speaker A: आज का चैलेंज, इमेजिन करो तुम इंटरव्यू में हो, मैं इंटरव्यूअर हूँ। मेरा एक सवाल है, "Tell me about yourself", इंग्लिश में जवाब दो। भाई साहब, आप पहले। "Tell me about yourself". [Today's challenge, imagine you are in an interview, I am the interviewer. I have a question, "Tell me about yourself", answer in English. Brother, you first. "Tell me about yourself".]
Speaker B: My name is Rahul. I am from Delhi. I have done graduation... मुझे इंग्लिश में नहीं आ रहा आगे क्या बोलूं। [My name is Rahul. I am from Delhi. I have done graduation... I don't know what to say next in English.]
Speaker A: कोई नहीं। मैडम, आप ट्राई करेंगी? "Tell me about yourself". [No problem. Madam, will you try? "Tell me about yourself".]
Speaker C: Myself Pooja. I am belonging to Lucknow. My qualification is BA pass. I am having experience of... सॉरी भाई, बहुत नर्वस हो गई। [Myself Pooja. I am belonging to Lucknow. My qualification is BA pass. I am having experience of... Sorry brother, I got very nervous.]
Speaker A: कोई नहीं मैडम। भाई साहब, आप बताइए। "Tell me about yourself". [No problem, Madam. Brother, you tell us. "Tell me about yourself".]
Speaker D: Sir, I am Amit. I am working in... मतलब मैं काम करता हूँ। नहीं यार, इंग्लिश में नहीं बन रहा। [Sir, I am Amit. I am working in... I mean I work. No man, it's not coming in English.]
Speaker A: अच्छा, कोई है जो ट्राई करना चाहेगा? [Okay, is there anyone who wants to try?]
Speaker E: मैं ट्राई करता हूँ। [I will try.]
Speaker A: श्योर, "Tell me about yourself". [Sure, "Tell me about yourself".]
Speaker E: Good morning sir. My name is Vishal and I am from Jaipur. I have completed my graduation in Commerce and I have two years of experience in retail sales. I am a quick learner and I enjoy working with people. I am looking for a role where I can use my communication skills and grow professionally. Thank you.
Speaker A: क्या बात है भाई! ये तो एक्चुअल इंटरव्यू जैसा था। इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कहाँ से सीखी? [Wow, brother! This was like an actual interview. Where did you learn such good English?]
Speaker E: English Seekho ऐप से। एक्सपर्ट के वीडियो देखे, हिंदी में समझा के इंटरव्यू की इंग्लिश सिखाती हैं और AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस की, रोज़ 15 मिनट। बस इतना किया। [From the English Seekho app. Watched expert videos, they teach interview English by explaining in Hindi, and practiced with the AI coach for 15 minutes daily. That's all I did.]
Speaker A: सुना आपने? इंटरव्यू में कॉन्फिडेंस चाहिए तो English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। ट्रायल सिर्फ ₹1 का। आप भी अपना इंट्रोडक्शन परफेक्ट करो। [Did you hear that? If you want confidence in interviews, download the English Seekho app. Trial is for just ₹1. You too make your introduction perfect.]
Speaker F: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An interviewer on the street asks passersby to introduce themselves in English for a mock interview. While most struggle and get nervous, one man delivers a flawless introduction, attributing his success to the English Seekho app. The ad promotes the app's expert videos and AI coach, offering a trial for just ₹1.
